The healed leper is told to show himself to the priests (Luke 17:14). In Acts 9:39, the widows at Joppa show Peter the garments Dorcas had made. The word carries a note of exhibition or proof — not merely seeing but deliberately presenting something for inspection. Spanish 'mostrar,' French 'montrer,' and German 'zeigen' all confirm this demonstrative force, the act of making visible what needs to be seen or verified."
